FALSE, knitr.table.html.attr = "quarto-disable-processing=true" ) ``` ```{r plot-maps} #| fig-align: "center" #| fig-height: 7.5 # load data micro_df <- readRDS("data/micro_df.rds") # plot temperature maps micro_df |> filter(as.character(z) %in% c("-0.04", "1.8")) |> mutate( z = factor( z, levels = c("1.8", "-0.04"), labels = c( "Lizard Body Temperature in Canopy", "Lizard Body Temperature in Leaf Litter" ) ) ) |> ggplot(aes(x = lon, y = lat)) + geom_tile(aes(fill = min_annual_body_temp)) + geom_tile( data = micro_df |> select(lon, lat, presence) |> distinct() |> filter(presence == 1), aes(x = lon, y = lat), fill = "forestgreen", alpha = 0.2 ) + geom_contour( aes(x = lon, y = lat, z = presence, color = "Range"), linewidth = 0.5 ) + geom_contour( aes(x = lon, y = lat, z = min_annual_body_temp, color = "0 °C"), breaks = c(0), linewidth = 1 ) + geom_contour( aes(x = lon, y = lat, z = min_annual_body_temp, color = "CTmin"), breaks = c(7), linewidth = 1 ) + scale_color_manual( name = NULL, values = c( "0 °C" = "steelblue4", "CTmin" = "skyblue", "Range" = "forestgreen" ), breaks = c("0 °C", "CTmin", "Range"), labels = expression(bold("0 °C"), bold(CT[min]), bold("Range")) ) + scale_fill_viridis( option = "magma", guide = guide_colorbar( title.position = "top", label.position = "left", barheight = unit(5, "cm") ), breaks = seq(-10, 25, 10), labels = paste0(seq(-10, 25, 10), " °C"), ) + scale_x_continuous( breaks = seq(-100, -70, 5), labels = paste0(seq(100, 70, -5), "°W"), expand = c(0, 0) ) + scale_y_continuous( breaks = seq(0, 45, 2.5), labels = paste0(seq(0, 45, 2.5), "°N"), expand = c(0, 0) ) + facet_wrap( ~ z, ncol = 1, axes = "all" ) + coord_quickmap(xlim = c(-101, -75), ylim = c(24, 38)) + theme_minimal() + guides( color = guide_legend( label.position = "left", override.aes = list(linewidth = 2), theme = theme( legend.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"), legend.key.spacing.y = unit(0.5, "cm") ) ) ) + theme( linewidth = 0.5 ) + scale_fill_gradient( low = "lightgoldenrod1", high = "darkgreen", guide = guide_colorbar( title.position = "top", label.position = "left", barheight = unit(5, "cm") ), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), labels = paste0(seq(0, 1, 0.2) * 100, "%"), ) + scale_x_continuous( breaks = seq(-100, -70, 5), labels = paste0(seq(100, 70, -5), "°W"), expand = c(0, 0) ) + scale_y_continuous( breaks = seq(0, 45, 2.5), labels = paste0(seq(0, 45, 2.5), "°N"), expand = c(0, 0) ) + coord_quickmap(xlim = c(-101, -75), ylim = c(24, 38)) + theme_minimal() + guides( color = guide_legend( label.position = "left", override.aes = list(linewidth = 2), theme = theme( legend.text = element_text(size = 14), legend.key.spacing.y = unit(0.5, "cm") ) ) ) + theme( legend.position = "left", legend.box = "vertical", legend.box.just = "left", legend.box.spacing = unit(0.1, "cm"), legend.key.width = unit(0.5, "cm"), legend.text = element_text(size = 10), legend.title = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.25), strip.text = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 16, hjust = 0.5), plot.title = element_text(size = 17, hjust = 0.5), plot.margin = margin(r = 10, t = -10, b = -10, l = 10) ) + labs( title = "Tree Cover" ) ``` ```{r plot-example-otm-dynamic} #| fig-align: "center" #| fig-width: 7 #| fig-height: 4 # read data otm_data <- readRDS("data/otms-data.rds") # plot example OTM dynamic otm_data |> filter(location %in% c("ATL", "MIA")) |> mutate( location = factor( location, levels = c("MIA", "ATL"), labels = c("Miami (25.7 °N)", "Atlanta (33.7 °N)") ) ) |> filter(doy == 19) |> mutate(hour = round(mod / 60)) |> group_by(location, microhabitat, hour) |> summarise( mean_temp = mean(temp, na.rm = TRUE), sd_temp = sd(temp, na.rm = TRUE), ) |> ggplot(aes(x = hour, y = mean_temp, color = microhabitat)) + annotate( "segment", x = -Inf, xend = Inf, y = 0, yend = 0, linetype = 2, color = "steelblue4" ) + annotate( "text", x = 18, y = 9.5, label = expression(bold(CT[min])), color = "skyblue", hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 5 ) + annotate( "segment", x = -Inf, xend = Inf, y = 9, yend = 9, linetype = 2, color = "skyblue" ) + geom_ribbon( aes( ymin = mean_temp - sd_temp, ymax = mean_temp + sd_temp, fill = microhabitat ), alpha = 0.2 ) + scale_fill_manual( values = c("forestgreen", "darkorange"), labels = c("Canopy", "Leaf Litter"), name = NULL ) + scale_color_manual( values = c("forestgreen", "darkorange"), labels = c("Canopy", "Leaf Litter"), name = NULL ) + facet_wrap(~location, axes = "all", ncol = 2, as.table = TRUE) + theme_minimal() + scale_x_continuous( breaks = seq(0, 24, 6), labels = paste0(seq(0, 24, 6), ":00"), expand = c(0, 0) ) + theme( panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5), axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.25), strip.text = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"), legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(1, 1), legend.justification = c(1, 1), legend.background = element_blank(), legend.text = element_text(size = 14), panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text = element_text(size = 10), axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14), panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"), plot.margin = margin(r = 15, l = 10, b = 5) ) + labs( y = "Lizard Body Temperature (°C)" ) ```
